candidate_workaround: Split Git and filesystem state inspection into independently bounded exact-purpose probes.
failure_signature: A combined closeout startup probe times out before any constituent result can receive evidence credit.
recurrence_guard: Never combine exact-head, tracked-delta, and untracked-surface inspection in one short Windows wrapper on a large worktree.
rollback: Retain the timeout with zero credit and make no repository mutation before bounded probes succeed.
scope_boundary: Read-only Ilyra closeout preflight only; no canonical-final or independent-reproduction credit.
title: Split large-worktree closeout startup probes
trigger_preconditions: A Windows worktree closeout preflight needs exact Git and declared-path state.
